facts.claim: Aroma Suites (Fira) has a Weddings page saying it hosts small ceremonies on its rooftop terrace above the caldera: elopements for two, vow renewals and celebrations of up to 15-20 guests.

Aroma Suites lists ceremony packages: Caldera Ceremonies on the rooftop terrace; an elopement package that 'includes the ceremony, a local photographer, flowers, and champagne on the rooftop terrace'; and sunset vow renewals with flowers, champagne and a photographer arranged.
Aroma Suites says it offers full planning support, handling 'florist, photographer, musician, legal paperwork' through local Santorini vendors it has used for years.

Aroma Suites describes three ways to marry there: (1) rent the rooftop terrace for the ceremony and the couple handles the rest; (2) buy out the whole hotel, with additional rooms at a nearby property arranged for larger groups and the reception on the terrace 'at extra cost'; (3) the hotel arranges details such as photographer, decor, flowers and catering, 'each at extra cost'.

Aroma Suites says pricing is tailored to date, group size and how much the hotel arranges; every wedding is a special request and couples contact the hotel with date and group size for prices and availability. No prices are published on the page.
Aroma Suites says ceremonies can be held at sunset, in the morning or after dark, and the couple can stay in its Honeymoon Suite the same night.

Kivotos Santorini's Luxury Weddings page says it hosts exclusive weddings and invites couples to combine the celebration with a hotel buyout for a villa-like experience with family and friends staying on site.

Kivotos Santorini's wedding enquiry form lists three named wedding packages, 'The Dreamy Life', 'The Live Life' and 'The Get Together' (plus 'Other'); the page does not describe what each package includes.

Vedema, a Luxury Collection Resort (Megalochori), states on its Marriott events page that it provides wedding services; ceremonies can be held at the resort, on the beach or elsewhere, with receptions at the Pool Restaurant or, for more privacy, the Canava Wine Bar; a private beach bonfire and barbecue are also offered.
Vedema's events page says its 400-year-old wine cellar can hold up to 120 guests for a banquet and 150 for a reception; its Thira Conference Center is listed at 75 (theatre).

Vedema's events page says a dedicated Celebration Consultant will arrange local support services, photographer and videographer, custom floral arrangements for the bride and venue, wedding cake and musical entertainment; optional arrangements include personalised menus and private dining, a horse-drawn carriage and fireworks.

Vedema's events page says the resort attends to 'all of the legal documents necessary to marry on Santorini' and can provide flowers, music or DJ, hairdresser, make-up artist, spa treatments, photographer and videographer and customised food and wine menus; its Elios Spa's two salon suites can be reserved together for the bridal party on the wedding day.

Vedema's events page publishes per-person catering prices for events (amounts not recorded here) and a separate Honeymoon Package that includes a complimentary candlelit dinner, a signature honeymoon amenity and flower bed decoration.

insider_details.detail: Small Fira boutique hotels can split the wedding into tiers: venue hire only, full buyout, or the hotel arranging suppliers, with each supplier charged on top; ask which tier a quote covers before comparing it with a resort package.
A named package is not a list of inclusions: Kivotos names three packages on its enquiry form but does not describe them, so request the written inclusions for the package named in any quote.

Capacity varies sharply by venue type: a Fira rooftop terrace suits up to 15-20 guests, while Vedema's wine cellar seats up to 120 for a banquet; match the guest list to the space before shortlisting.

Where a venue says it handles legal paperwork (Aroma, Vedema), confirm in writing exactly which documents it prepares and which the couple must obtain through the Municipality of Thira and the embassy.
